reason: Change is localized to WYSIWYG editor views/settings and admin CSS, swapping undo/redo for a Trumbowyg history plugin and adding a min-height style, but relies on the plugin script being registered correctly (asp-name resource) and could break the editor toolbar if the resource manifest for 'trumbowyg-plugins' isn't defined, so worth a quick check but low blast radius on core CMS behavior.
